// FUNC 18004a640 _RawDllMainProxy
__int64 __fastcall RawDllMainProxy(__int64 a1, unsigned int a2, __int64 a3)
{
  __int64 result; // rax

  if ( RawDllMain == nullptr )
    return 1;
  result = IsNonwritableInCurrentImage(&pActualRawDllMain);
  if ( (_DWORD)result != 0 )
    return ((__int64 (__fastcall *)(__int64, _QWORD, __int64))RawDllMain)(a1, a2, a3);
  return result;
}

// FUNC 18004a6e8 _IsNonwritableInCurrentImage
char __fastcall IsNonwritableInCurrentImage(__int64 a1)
{

  int v2; // r8d
  unsigned __int64 v3; // r9
  __int64 v4; // r10
  unsigned int v5; // edx
  _DWORD *v6; // rcx
  unsigned __int64 v7; // r8

  if ( MEMORY[0x180000000] == 23117 )
  {
    v2 = MEMORY[0x18000003C];
    v1 = 0;
    if ( *(_DWORD *)(MEMORY[0x18000003C] + 0x180000000LL) == 17744 )
      LOBYTE(v1) = *(_WORD *)(MEMORY[0x18000003C] + 0x180000018LL) == 523;
  }
  else
  {
    v1 = 0;
    v2 = MEMORY[0x18000003C];
  }
  if ( v1 != 0 )
  {
    v3 = a1 - 0x180000000LL;
    v4 = 0x180000000LL + v2;
    v5 = 0;
    v6 = (_DWORD *)(*(unsigned __int16 *)(0x180000014LL + v2) + 0x180000018LL + v2);
    while ( v5 < *(unsigned __int16 *)(v4 + 6) )
    {
      v7 = (unsigned int)v6[3];
      if ( v3 >= v7 && v3 < (unsigned int)(v7 + v6[2]) )
        goto LABEL_12;
      ++v5;
      v6 += 10;
    }
    v6 = nullptr;
LABEL_12:
    LOBYTE(v1) = v6 != nullptr && (int)v6[9] >= 0;
  }
  return v1;
}
